# Aimfox

> Aimfox is a LinkedIn automation tool for personalized outreach across multiple profiles, with every reply in one inbox.

Aimfox automates LinkedIn outreach for sales teams, agencies and recruiters. It sends connection requests, messages and follow-ups from one or many LinkedIn profiles and puts every reply in one inbox. Teams can rent extra LinkedIn profiles as Aimfox Avatars. Agencies can run Aimfox under their own brand. Developers can run campaigns through the API, webhooks and the MCP server.

LinkedIn Outreach costs $69 a seat per month. The Agency plan costs $699 a month for 20 seats. Aimfox Avatars cost $387 a month for a pack of 3. Each Avatar includes its own Outreach seat. 7 days free on Outreach. No credit card required. 30-day money-back guarantee on Agency. Yearly billing costs less. The pricing page has the current prices.

The name is written Aimfox: one word with a capital A.
